information.title: Doping can operate as an organised system
information.body: The 2016 McLaren Independent Investigation for the World Anti-Doping Agency reported an institutionalised doping conspiracy involving athletes and officials across multiple Russian sporting and state organisations. The athletes concerned were operating within an organised infrastructure rather than simply acting as isolated individuals.
information.source_note: WADA — McLaren Independent Investigation Report, Part II (2016).

information.title: The system operated across major competitions
information.body: The same investigation described a systematic and centralised process for manipulating doping controls across several major international competitions, with sample-swapping practices continuing beyond the Sochi 2014 Winter Olympics.
information.source_note: WADA — McLaren Independent Investigation Report, Part II (2016).
